instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Contract research organization providing clinical trial management, biostatistics, and regulatory submission services to pharma and biotech sponsors. Managing 40 active clinical trials across 25 countries. Evaluating risk-based monitoring platforms and AI-assisted adverse event case processing from clinical narratives. Multi-department organization with formalized budgets, quarterly business reviews, and a dedicated strategy function. We have invested in core systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS) but these are not always well-integrated. Innovation is a standing agenda item at board level with annual investment allocated, but execution velocity varies across business units.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team adopted an agile methodology last year, moving from waterfall-style quarterly releases to 2-week sprints with continuous deployment. This reduced our release cycle time by 60% and improved cross-functional collaboration. However, adjacent teams (marketing, support) are still adapting to the faster cadence.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.
answers.additionalContext: We completed a merger with a similarly-sized competitor 4 months ago and are in the middle of integrating teams, systems, and processes. The combined organization has significant duplication — two CRMs, two HR systems, overlapping product lines. There is a unique window to redesign processes from scratch rather than patching legacy approaches, but cultural integration is fragile and change fatigue is real.

input.changes_since_last: Regulatory changes forced compliance reviews. 6 new standard procedures implemented. Team morale improving.

opportunities.title: Establish a Managed Data Commons for Clinical Outcomes (CDO)
opportunities.rationale: The industry needs standardized, federated data access. Leveraging the combined network's unique patient and trial data assets to create a secure CDO platform is a radical diversification step that moves beyond service delivery into asset monetization. This requires solving deep integration challenges created by the merger.

first_actions: Form an inter-departmental Data Governance Committee (DGC) including legal and compliance stakeholders.
Map data schema requirements across the two legacy CRMs/systems to identify core, transferable datasets.
Pilot a secure, anonymized data sharing agreement with one key strategic partner for initial validation.
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful deployment of a functional, anonymized data sandbox available to internal stakeholders within 9 months.

opportunities.title: Standardize Global Core Process Workflow (CRM/HRIS Consolidation)
opportunities.rationale: The merger created significant process duplication and cultural friction. By focusing on consolidating 2-3 core processes (e.g., Adverse Event Reporting, Resource Allocation) into a single, unified standard workflow, Apex can immediately reduce operational drag and improve speed. This is an essential foundation for radical efforts.

first_actions: Select the 'best-of-breed' process model (e.g., which CRM handles adverse event reporting most effectively) via a cross-functional workshop.
Develop and implement mandatory, compliance-checked SOPs for the consolidated workflow.
Conduct targeted training for end-users on the single, optimized process flow.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of manual effort time spent on the consolidated workflow by 40% within 6 months.
milestones: Process mapping and gap analysis completed (Q1).
System configuration changes finalized and tested (Q2).
Go-live with minimal process variance reported.

next_steps.action: Formalize the Data Governance Committee (DGC) charter and secure compliance sign-off on initial data usage protocols for Opp A.
Execute the 'Process Workshop' phase of Opp B, involving stakeholders from both merged entities to achieve consensus on the single source of truth workflow.
Leverage the '20% time' policy to dedicate a dedicated squad to building a digital process map of current state workflows (opp_B) for visualization and gap analysis.

key_weaknesses: Fragmented systems landscape due to the recent merger, leading to process duplication (two CRMs, two HRIS).
Fragile cultural integration and change fatigue among staff, slowing adoption of new processes.
Lack of formalized, governed data standards necessary for large-scale asset diversification.

improvements: Successful adoption and scaling of Agile methodology within engineering teams (60% release cycle reduction).
Implementation of 6 new standard procedures following regulatory changes.
Increased visibility into strategic opportunities (board-level diversification focus).
persistent_gaps: Integration gaps remain high across operational processes and core systems.
Cross-departmental cultural alignment is still weak, creating resistance to standardized workflows.
Data assets are siloed or poorly governed, hindering large-scale platform development.
achieved_milestones: completion of necessary steps for Opp 2 (advanced)
Adoption of sprint methodology in product teams
Formalization of annual board-level innovation budget commitment

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant operational gains (Agile adoption, regulatory compliance) and clear strategic direction toward diversification were achieved following the merger, shifting focus from core process stability to asset leveraging.
